Name: Bigger Greenhouse For Iridium Sprinklers Content Patcher Unofficial
Author: zukane2
Description:
Requires latest version of [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]
Requires latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ by [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild

[/url][b]Version 2.0 changes:
- Converted greenhouse.xnb to greenhouse big.tmx/greenhouse bigger.tmx
[b]- Removed the unnecessary entrance and hallway[/b]
- Added a config.json to switch between Big and Bigger
- Compatible with [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b]

This is the Content Patcher version of Bigger Greenhouse For Iridium Sprinklers by Cylesburk.
You can check out his work by clicking [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1472?tab=description]HERE[/url].

[b]How to install the mod:
[/b]1. Download the mod
2. Open the zip file
3. Extract it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[b]-As of version 2.0 you can now switch between 2 versions of greenhouses. Type "Big" or "Bigger" on GreenhouseType. You have to run the game at least once to generate config.json.[/b]

To uninstall the mod you just have to delete ""[b][CP] Bigger Greenhouse For Iridium Sprinklers Content Patcher Unofficial[/b]" folder from Stardew Valley/Mods.

Warning: If you currently have crops on your greenhouse you might want to harvest and pick up everything before installing this mod

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/47762598]Cylesburk[/url] if you want me to remove this I will gladly do it.
